title: fix(plugin-dashboard): draw a declared gap: 0 with no gap
body:
Fixes #36912
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 搭仪表盘的人在仪表盘里写了组件间距为零后,卡片现在会紧贴着画出来,以前仍隔着一段默认间距;没写间距的仪表盘不变。
- 属于仪表盘渲染的修正:规范允许间距为零,渲染器却把零当成没写。
- 出错时只是卡片之间的空隙不对,不丢数据,可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx` read the declared gap as `schema.gap || 4`, so a declared `gap: 0` (legal: `gap: z.number().int().min(0).optional()`, `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`) fell through to the default 4 (1rem). It now reads `schema.gap ?? 4`; only an absent `gap` takes the default.

Every reader of the declared gap in `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, read at `b01d8f97`:

- `DashboardRenderer.tsx` line 409, `const gap = schema.gap || 4` - the only reader of `schema.gap`; fixed here.
- `DashboardRenderer.tsx` `gapPx={gap * 4}` on the design-mode resize handle - derives from the same `gap` constant, so it now sees the declared zero too; no `||` of its own.
- `DashboardRenderer.tsx` desktop grid root `gap: gap * 0.25 rem` inline style - derives from the same constant; this is what the test reads.
- The mobile body (`flex flex-col gap-4`, metric grid `gap-3`) does not read `schema.gap` at all: fixed Tailwind classes, no `||`, unchanged. Noted below.
- `index.tsx` declares `{ name: 'gap', type: 'number' }` as a block input; `DashboardConfigPanel.tsx` edits it. Neither defaults it.

## Live observation

The issue asks for a live measurement first. A browser on a dev server needs a full monorepo build plus the Console build in a container shared with two sibling dev agents, where each verify-lock call already queued 4 to 9 minutes; I judged that impractical here and took the reading the dispatch allows instead: the real `DashboardRenderer`, rendered by the new test, reading the grid root's inline `gap` style.

| schema | before (`b01d8f97` renderer) | after |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `gap: 0` | `1rem` (test red: Expected "0rem", Received "1rem") | `0rem` |
| `gap` absent | `1rem` | `1rem` |
| `gap: 2` | `0.5rem` | `0.5rem` |

## Tests

New `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.gapZero-36912.test.tsx`: renders `gap: 0` and asserts the grid root's style `gap` is `0rem`, with the absent-`gap` control (`1rem`) and a non-zero case (`0.5rem`). It was committed before the fix and run red against the unfixed renderer (1 failed, 2 passed), then green after (3 passed).

## Acceptance notes

- The mobile layout ignores the declared `gap` entirely (fixed `gap-4` / `gap-3`). That is the phone layout's own spacing, not a `||` reader, and outside this card; not filed.
- Outside this package, `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-bar.tsx` reads `schema.gap || 'gap-2'`, but its `gap` is a class string, where only an empty string falls through; not the same defect, not filed.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `cd ui/packages/plugin-dashboard && pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.gapZero-36912.test.tsx` - expect 3 passed; revert line 409 to `||` and the `gap: 0` case reads `1rem`.
